description: A milestone as a shareable image, like the site’s Stat Shot: a big number or short text (e.g. “10,000”), a label (“followers on X”), an optional tag, message, name, handle, date and profile photo. Layouts: big (the number as large as it fits), centre, profile (a card with your photo), chart (a line climbing to the top right), badge (the number in a ring), headline (the label as a large headline: a new job, a launch), board (each character on a flip tile). Backgrounds: plain, gradient, glow, grid, dots, rays, waves, confetti, or image. Sizes: square 1080×1080, portrait 1080×1350, portrait-34 1080×1440, story 1080×1920, landscape 1600×900. PNGs in ~/Downloads/one-design. On the Free plan each image carries a small “Made with one.design” credit in the bottom right corner, as on the site; Pro has none.

accent.description: Accent colour (tag, label, chart, ring), hex like #c9f26b.

background_design.description: plain, gradient, glow, grid, dots, rays, waves, confetti, or image (needs background_image).

dim.description: How much of the background colour lies over your image (0 to 80%), so the words stay readable.

font.description: Font for the number and headline: sans (Inter), serif (Instrument Serif) or mono (JetBrains Mono).

kicker.description: A small tag above it (empty for none).

label.description: What it counts, e.g. “followers on X”, or for headline “Designer at Acme”.

layout.description: big, centre, profile, chart, badge, headline or board.

message.description: An optional short message, e.g. “Thank you for being here.”

photo.description: A profile photo (optional); without one, the profile layout shows your initials.

value.description: The number or big text, e.g. “10,000”, “10K” or “New role”.

name: make_stat_shot
title: Make a milestone image (Stat Shot)
